knowledge:
- key_parameters: narrowPeaks=GRanges of feature ranges with 'name' metadata column, named after experiment source ;; peaks=GRanges of feature positions with 'name' metadata column, named after experiment source ;; chrInfo=Seqinfo object containing chromosome names and lengths ;; extendingSize=Half of the initial window size (in bp) used to cluster feature positions ;; expandToFitPeakRegion=Logical; if TRUE, resizes consensus region to fit maximum of included features when outside initial window ;; shrinkToFitPeakRegion=Logical; if TRUE, resizes consensus region to fit minimum of included features when inside initial window ;; minNbrExp=Minimum number of experiments with at least one feature inside a region to retain it ;; nbrThreads=Number of threads for parallel processing
- alternatives: Extracting overlapping regions of genomic ranges (standard intersection/union using GenomicRanges/IRanges)=Overlapping can miss regions if one experiment has a slightly shifted or missing feature, while union can result in excessively wide consensus ranges. consensusSeekeR is preferred when precise feature positions (like peak summits or nucleosome centers) are available and tighter, position-centric consensus regions are desired.
- when_to_use: When analyzing replicates or multiple experiments of genomic features that generate a specific position value surrounded by a genomic range, such as ChIP-Seq peaks (MACS2/PeakRanger outputs) or nucleosome positions (PING/NOrMAL/NucPosSimulator outputs).
- pitfalls: Both narrowPeaks and peaks GRanges must have identical row names representing the experiment source. Each feature must have a unique identifier in the 'name' metadata column that is identical between the peaks and narrowPeaks GRanges to pair them correctly. narrowPeaks is mandatory only if expandToFitPeakRegion and/or shrinkToFitPeakRegion are set to TRUE. If new feature positions are added during the consensus region resizing, the iterative clustering steps are not reprocessed.

workflows.name: chip_seq_consensus_from_narrowpeak
workflows.intent: Identify consensus peak regions from multiple ChIP-Seq replicates or experiments starting from NarrowPeak files.
input: file_narrowPeak (NarrowPeak formatted file containing peak regions and peak summits)
chrList (Seqinfo object with chromosome names and lengths)
workflows.stages:
1. Load NarrowPeak files using readNarrowPeakFile to extract both regions and peak positions.
2. Assign experiment names as row names to the GRanges objects.
3. Assign unique feature names to the name metadata column of both GRanges objects to pair them.
4. Define chromosome information using Seqinfo.
5. Run findConsensusPeakRegions to identify consensus regions.
workflows.code:
library(consensusSeekeR)

### Demo file contained within the consensusSeekeR package
file_narrowPeak <- system.file("extdata",
    "A549_FOSL2_ENCSR000BQO_MZW_part_chr_1_and_12.narrowPeak", package = "consensusSeekeR")

### Create genomic ranges for both the regions and the peaks
result <- readNarrowPeakFile(file_narrowPeak, extractRegions = TRUE, extractPeaks = TRUE)

### First rows of each GRanges object
head(result$narrowPeak, n = 2)
head(result$peak, n = 2)

### Loading datasets
data(A549_CTCF_MYN_NarrowPeaks_partial) ; data(A549_CTCF_MYN_Peaks_partial)
data(A549_CTCF_MYJ_NarrowPeaks_partial) ; data(A549_CTCF_MYJ_Peaks_partial)

### Assigning experiment name "rep01" to the first replicate
names(A549_CTCF_MYJ_NarrowPeaks_partial) <- rep("rep01", length(A549_CTCF_MYJ_NarrowPeaks_partial))
names(A549_CTCF_MYJ_Peaks_partial)       <- rep("rep01", length(A549_CTCF_MYJ_Peaks_partial))

### Assigning experiment name "rep02" to the second replicate
names(A549_CTCF_MYN_NarrowPeaks_partial) <- rep("rep02", length(A549_CTCF_MYN_NarrowPeaks_partial))
names(A549_CTCF_MYN_Peaks_partial)       <- rep("rep02", length(A549_CTCF_MYN_Peaks_partial))

### Only choromsome 10 is going to be analyzed
chrList <- Seqinfo("chr10", 135534747, NA)

### Find consensus regions with both replicates inside it
results <- findConsensusPeakRegions(
            narrowPeaks = c(A549_CTCF_MYJ_NarrowPeaks_partial, A549_CTCF_MYN_NarrowPeaks_partial),
            peaks = c(A549_CTCF_MYJ_Peaks_partial, A549_CTCF_MYN_Peaks_partial),
            chrInfo = chrList,
            extendingSize = 100,
            expandToFitPeakRegion = TRUE,
            shrinkToFitPeakRegion = TRUE,
            minNbrExp = 2,
            nbrThreads = 1)

### Print the call 
results$call

### Print the 3 first consensus regions
head(results$consensusRanges, n = 3)

workflows.name: nucleosome_position_consensus
workflows.intent: Compare nucleosome positioning results from different software tools to find consensus nucleosome positions.
input: NOrMAL_nucleosome_positions (GRanges of nucleosome center positions from NOrMAL)
NOrMAL_nucleosome_ranges (GRanges of nucleosome occupancy ranges from NOrMAL)
PING_nucleosome_positions (GRanges of nucleosome center positions from PING)
PING_nucleosome_ranges (GRanges of nucleosome occupancy ranges from PING)
NucPosSimulator_nucleosome_positions (GRanges of nucleosome center positions from NucPosSimulator)
NucPosSimulator_nucleosome_ranges (GRanges of nucleosome occupancy ranges from NucPosSimulator)
chrList (Seqinfo object with chromosome names and lengths)
workflows.stages:
1. Load nucleosome position and range datasets.
2. Assign software names as row names to the GRanges objects.
3. Define chromosome information using Seqinfo.
4. Run findConsensusPeakRegions with custom parameters (extendingSize = 25, minNbrExp = 2).
workflows.code:
library(consensusSeekeR)

### Loading dataset from NOrMAL
data(NOrMAL_nucleosome_positions) ; data(NOrMAL_nucleosome_ranges)

### Loading dataset from PING
data(PING_nucleosome_positions) ; data(PING_nucleosome_ranges)

### Loading dataset from NucPosSimulator
data(NucPosSimulator_nucleosome_positions) ; data(NucPosSimulator_nucleosome_ranges)

### Assigning software name "NOrMAL" 
names(NOrMAL_nucleosome_positions) <- rep("NOrMAL", length(NOrMAL_nucleosome_positions))
names(NOrMAL_nucleosome_ranges) <- rep("NOrMAL", length(NOrMAL_nucleosome_ranges))

### Assigning experiment name "PING"
names(PING_nucleosome_positions) <- rep("PING", length(PING_nucleosome_positions))
names(PING_nucleosome_ranges) <- rep("PING", length(PING_nucleosome_ranges))

### Assigning experiment name "NucPosSimulator"
names(NucPosSimulator_nucleosome_positions) <- rep("NucPosSimulator", 
                                length(NucPosSimulator_nucleosome_positions))
names(NucPosSimulator_nucleosome_ranges) <- rep("NucPosSimulator", 
                                length(NucPosSimulator_nucleosome_ranges))

### Only choromsome 1 is going to be analyzed
chrList <- Seqinfo("chr1", 135534747, NA)

### Find consensus regions with both replicates inside it
results <- findConsensusPeakRegions(
            narrowPeaks = c(NOrMAL_nucleosome_ranges, PING_nucleosome_ranges,
                                NucPosSimulator_nucleosome_ranges),
            peaks = c(NOrMAL_nucleosome_positions, PING_nucleosome_positions,
                                NucPosSimulator_nucleosome_positions),
            chrInfo = chrList,
            extendingSize = 25,
            expandToFitPeakRegion = TRUE,
            shrinkToFitPeakRegion = TRUE,
            minNbrExp = 2,
            nbrThreads = 1)

### Print the call 
results$call

### Print the 3 first consensus regions
head(results$consensusRanges, n = 3)
